clips.title: The story
paras: Near Auberdine, travelers gather Moonstalker Fangs for Wizbang Cranktoggle's sampling devices. The teeth come from the moonstalkers of Darkshore.

Moonstalker Fangs come from saber cats that hunt along Darkshore’s forest fringes. Their long teeth can shear flesh and bone. Wizbang Cranktoggle, an eccentric gnome tinkerer, uses them in a different way. North of Auberdine, near the bridge, Buzzbox 323 crushes the durable fangs to dust for his ecological surveys.
